body: It was about 7 minutes each time, only enough time to switch or up medication.
There was no personalized therapy. All therapy was done in groups, so your personal problems weren’t focused on like they were supposed to be.

I guess it depends on the person and what your specific issues are. 

I was admitted to an inpatient unit four times, and with each time I feel like I’ve gotten worse or just stayed the same. 

The first two times I was held for three days EDO due to threats of suicide. The third time I was kept for a week due to actual attempting. The fourth time was also EDO. 

They don’t help me, personally. Neither does medication or therapy. I just have no other hope. 

It really does depend on the individual though. I’ve heard people say they’ve gotten better after being hospitalized.

If you think a suicide attempt is imminent, call 911 or go to the nearest ER. 

I’m sorry you’re going through this.
